name: Grelin Whitebeard's Journal
summary: Grelin Whitebeard's Journal is a personal field notebook kept by the dwarf scout Grelin Whitebeard in Coldridge Valley. Containing critical notes on local Frostmane troll activity, the journal was stolen by the chieftain Grik'nir the Cold and dragged into the troll cave in Coldridge Valley.

sections.title: A Scout's Ledger
sections.body: While observing the aggressive movements of the Frostmane trolls near Coldridge Valley, Grelin Whitebeard diligently recorded his findings in this leatherbound notebook. The document contains his raw field observations regarding the strength, organization, and threat level posed by the indigenous winter trolls. However, during a confrontation or ambush, the journal was snatched away by Grik'nir the Cold—a heavily marked troll leader—forcing Grelin to recruit passing adventurers to delve into the troll cave and wrest it back before his report could be finalized.

sections.title: Dispatch to Senir
sections.body: Once recovered from Grik'nir's clutches, the notes inside this battered journal provide Grelin with enough reassurance to assess the Coldridge Valley troll threat as temporarily contained. Using the recovered jottings, Grelin finalizes his written dispatch on the Frostmane uprising, which is subsequently sealed and entrusted to couriers bound for his brother Senir Whitebeard stationed further abroad in Dun Morogh.

faq.answer: The journal was taken by Grik'nir the Cold, a prominent and heavily marked Frostmane troll brute residing deep inside the troll cave in Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: What is written in the journal?
faq.answer: The journal contains Grelin Whitebeard's direct reconnaissance notes regarding the local Frostmane trolls, their threat level, and the state of safety within Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: What happens after the journal is recovered?
aliases: what does grelin do with the journal
faq.answer: After retrieving his notebook, Grelin uses his notes to write a finalized intelligence report on the troll situation, which he then asks an adventurer to deliver to his brother, Senir Whitebeard.

faq.q: Why is this journal so important to Grelin?
aliases: why does grelin want it back
faq.answer: Without his notebook, Grelin cannot compile an accurate scouting report on the Frostmane uprising for the dwarven authorities and his brother Senir, leaving Coldridge Valley's defenses uncertain.

angles.text: Recovering this journal safeguards crucial dwarven intelligence on the Frostmane threat encroaching on the very gates of Ironforge's training grounds.
